GPTR-F-001-S166.title: Allowlist Schema and Query Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S166.description: Define a strict allowlist schema and request contract for GPTReader queries, including permitted collections, fields, operators, and limit constraints, implemented via Pydantic models aligned with existing validation patterns.

GPTR-F-001-S167.title: Request Normalization and Pre-Validation Layer
GPTR-F-001-S167.description: Implement a preprocessing layer that normalizes incoming GPTReader requests (field casing, operator standardization, limit defaults) before allowlist enforcement to ensure consistent evaluation and eliminate ambiguity.

GPTR-F-001-S168.title: Audit Logging for Enforcement Decisions
GPTR-F-001-S168.description: Extend GPTReader audit logging to capture allowlist enforcement decisions, including rejected queries, rule violations, and metadata for traceability without exposing sensitive data.
